title: 'Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero' Reveals Production Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content:
The official website for the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ) revealed production staff, theme songs, a main visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Saturday. The prequel anime movie to Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom ) is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on January 15, 2027.

Staff Director: Mitsuo Fukuda ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ) Screenplay: Mitsuo Fukuda , Chiaki Morosawa ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED ), Shigeru Morita ( Kyochuu Rettou Movie script) NEW Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Hisashi Hirai ( Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - The Beyond ) Chief Mechanical Animation Director: Satoshi Shigeta ( Code Geass: Dakkan no Rozé ) Mechanical Design: Kunio Ookawara ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Cucuruz Doan no Shima ), Kimitoshi Yamane ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Fukushuu no Requiem ), Manabu Shintani ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ), Zenseava ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ), Takuya Io ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom ) Color Design: Akemi Nagao ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu 5th Season ) Art Director: Shigemi Ikeda ( One Punch Man ), Yukiko Maruyama ( Boku no Hero Academia ) CG Director: Mitsuhiro Satou ( Zegapain: STA ), Kensuke Kushida ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou 3DCG animation) Monitor Graphics: Azusa Tamura ( God Eater ), Jirou Kageyama ( Active Raid: Kidou Kyoushuushitsu Dai Hachi Gakari ) Director of Photography: Takeshi Kuzuyama ( Dr. Stone ), Ryou Iijima ( Hataraku Maou-sama!! ) NEW Editing: Yukiko Nojiri ( Gundam Breaker: Battlogue ) Sound Director: Sadayoshi Fujino ( Bakumatsu ) Music: Toshihiko Sahashi ( Tensai Ouji no Akaji Kokka Saisei Jutsu ) Planning, Production: Sunrise Production: Bandai Namco Filmworks

Note: The staff list includes members that have previously worked on previous entries in the franchise. The new members are denoted with legend NEW .

Takanori Nishikawa and Tetsuya Komuro are performing the opening theme "ABSOLUTE ZERO" and Japanese band See-Saw is performing the ending theme "Yuugure wo Matsu Nostalgia." Both theme songs are previewed in the main trailer below.

The original Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED ) television anime aired in 50 episodes from Fall 2002 to 2003. The 50-episode Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Destiny ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny ) sequel anime aired from Fall 2004–2005, followed by the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Destiny Final Plus: The Chosen Future OVA in December 2005. The latest installment, SEED Freedom movie, opened in theaters in Japan in January 2024, grossing over 5.22 billion yen (approx. US$34 million).

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals Song Artists, January 5 Debut in Video
content:
The staff for the second television anime season based on Ran Kuze 's Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsūjinai ) manga presented the full promotional video and a key visual on Saturday. The video announces the artists for the season's theme songs and the season's January 5 premiere.

The virtual YouTuber group duo HIMEHINA performs the opening theme song "Mechachū!!" (Amazing Smooch!!), and the idol group Straight Angeli performs the ending theme song "Hatsukoi no Distortion" (First-Love Distortion).

The new season will premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on January 5 at 24:00 (effectively, January 6 at midnight). It will then stream on the d Anime Store , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai services in Japan.

Mona is the cutest girl in school, and she knows it. In fact, she's worked hard to make her High School Debut successful. But no matter what she does, she can't seem to catch the eye of stone-cold stoic Medaka Kuroiwa—but she's not about to give up that easy. Medaka, on the other hand, has been raised at a temple and was told to never become close to women. Who will win in this heated battle of wills?

Ryōta Iwasaki and Yū Serizawa reprise their roles as Medaka Kuroiwa and Mona Kawai, respectively, in the new season.

Yoshiaki Okumura returns to direct the second season at Synergy SP . Yoriko Tomita ( The Elusive Samurai , My Dress-Up Darling two seasons, Senpai is an Otokonoko ) is in charge of series scripts, replacing Kazuyuki Fudeyasu . Mayumi Watanabe is again designing the characters, Nozomi Nakatani ( Too Cute Crisis , The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife ) joins Noriyoshi Konuma from the first season as sound director, Akiyuki Tateyama also returns to compose the music, and Aiko Yamagami returns as color designer. Shinichirō Nagano ( Mr. Villain's Day Off , A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai ) is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Tetsuya Nishimura , and Hiroki Matsumoto ( Gugure! Kokkuri-san , The Ossan Newbie Adventurer ) is the new art director, replacing Masakazu Miyake .

Crunchyroll will stream the new season in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and the CIS. The anime will have a premiere screening at this year's Anime Frontier event in Fort Worth, TX on December 6 alongside premieres of Shangri-La Frontier season 3 and Fate Rewinder .

The anime's first season premiered in January 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Kuze ( Tokyo Ravens: Sword of Song ) first published the manga as a one-shot story in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in December 2020. The manga started its full serialization in the magazine in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume in Japan in August 2021, and the 26th volume shipped on October 16.

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Anime's Trailer Unveils Theme Songs
content:
The staff for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO , the prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM anime film, unveiled its full trailer and a new key visual on Saturday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Absolute Zero" by Takanori Nishikawa with t.komuro, and also announces the ending theme song "Yūgure o Matsu Nostalgia" (Nostalgia Awaiting Twilight) by the group See-Saw .

The cast (which features returning members) includes:

• Kenichi Suzumura as Shinn Asuka

• Maaya Sakamoto as Lunamaria Hawke

• Houko Kuwashima as Agnes Giebenrath

• Daisuke Ono as Leonard Valway

• Sōichirō Hoshi as Kira Yamato

• Rie Tanaka as Lacus Clyne

• Akira Ishida as Athrun Zala

• Nanako Mori as Cagalli Yula Athha

• Tomokazu Seki as Yzak Jule

• Akira Sasanuma as Dearka Elthman

• Kotono Mitsuishi as Murrue Ramius

• Takehito Koyasu as Mu La Flaga

The English dub cast stars Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato, and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala.

The staff includes:

• Planning/Production: SUNRISE

• Original Concept: Hajime Yatate, Yoshiyuki Tomino

• Director: Mitsuo Fukuda

• Screenplay: Shigeru Morita, Chiaki Morosawa, Mitsuo Fukuda

• Character Design/Animation Director: Hisashi Hirai

• Mechanical Animation Director: Satoshi Shigeta

• Mechanical Design: Kunio Ōkawara, Kimitoshi Yamane, Manabu Shintani, zenseava, Takuya Io

• Color Design:Akemi Nagao

• Art Director: Shigemi Ikeda, Yukiko Maruyama

• CG Director: Mitsuhiro Sato, Kensuke Kushida

• Monitor Graphics: Azusa Tamura, Jirō Kageyama

• Director of Photography: Takeshi Katsurayama, Ryō Iijima

• Offline Editing: Yukiko Nojiri

• Sound Director: Sadayoshi Fujino

• Music: Toshihiko Sahashi

• Production: Bandai Namco Filmworks

• Distribution: Bandai Namco Filmworks, Shochiku Co. Ltd.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on January 15 and in North America in February 2027.

Director Mitsuo Fukuda , producer Hisakazu Naka , and Sōichirō Hoshi , voice of Kira Yamato, appeared at a stage greeting during the first screening announcing the prequel. They revealed that screenwriter Chiaki Morosawa and Shigeru Morita wrote the prequel's scenario while planning for Gundam Seed Freedom itself. In addition, Fukuda stated that the script for Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was completed 20 years ago.

Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO's storyboards were nearly half finished, and the oldest storyboards actually predate those of Gundam Seed Freedom itself. The dialogue recording has also already been completed. Fukuda added that 20 years ago, Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was originally planned as an original video anime ( OVA ), but the staff has not yet decided how it will be presented now.

Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM opened in Japan in January 2024. The film debuted at #1 in the Japanese box office. It sold 634,182 tickets for 1,065,983,130 yen (about US$7.20 million) in its first three days, marking the Gundam franchise 's highest three-day opening in box office earnings. The film is the highest-earning Gundam film in Japan ever.

Bandai Namco Filmworks and Fathom Events screened the film in the United States and Canada in May 2024. Netflix is streaming the film .

Special editions of the film screened in theaters in Japan in fall 2024. One version played with footage added to the end. Another special edition had different footage added (specifically, the above-mentioned teaser video).

Fukuda directed the film at Bandai Namco Filmworks . Fukuda also co-wrote the script along with his late wife Chiaki Morosawa and Liu Goto . Hisashi Hirai ( Mobile Suit Gundam Seed ) designed the characters.
author: ANN

title: 'Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Main Trailer, May 2027 Premiere
content:
The Shadow's Gathering 4th Anniversary special livestream event revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and the main trailer for the Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen ( The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes ) sequel film on Saturday. The movie adapting Daisuke Aizawa 's comedy fantasy light novel is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in May 2027.

Cast Cid Kagenou: Seiichirou Yamashita ( Horimiya ) Beta: Inori Minase ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Akane Nishino: Yui Horie ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) Mordred: Takehito Koyasu ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken (TV) ) Yuuka Asakura: Yukari Tamura ( Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ) NEW Minoru: Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama ) NEW

Staff Music: Kenichiro Suehiro ( Yomi no Tsugai ) Music Production: Kadokawa Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai ) Sound Production: Magic Capsule Distribution: Animec

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

Kazuya Nakanishi ( Comic Girls ) returns to direct the movie at Nexus , with Kanichi Katou ( Black Clover ) penning the script. Makoto Iino ( Tatoeba Last Dungeon Mae no Mura no Shounen ga Joban no Machi de Kurasu Youna Monogatari ) is designing the characters.

Produced by Nexus, the 20-episode first season aired in Fall 2022. The 12-episode second season aired in Fall 2023. HIDIVE streamed the first season and simulcast the second season with an English dub.

Aizawa originally published the story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in May 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the series under its Enterbrain label, with illustrations by Touzai , in November 2018. The seventh volume was released on April 1. The series has a cumulative 8 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Anri Sakano ( Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo? Z ) launched a manga adaptation in Monthly Comp Ace in December 2018. Kadokawa published the 19th volume on November 25.

The magazine also serialized a spin-off manga drawn by Seta U from July 2019 to September 2023. The sixth and final volume was released in October 2023.

A second spin-off manga titled, Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden: Shichikage Retsuden , by kanco , began serialization in Comp Ace Comic Connect magazine in May 2024. The fourth volume went on sale on September 25.

Yen Press licensed the light novel and manga adaptation in English in May 2019 and January 2021, respectively. The sixth light novel volume went on sale in February 2025, with the seventh light novel volume going on sale in March 2027. The 15th manga volume was released on September 22, with the 16th volume scheduled for a January 2027 release.

A role-playing video game developed by Aiming, titled The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden ), was released for Android, iOS, and Windows in Japan in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games launched the game worldwide for Android and iOS on the same day. The Windows version was released worldwide in May 2023, featuring cross-platform play and progression. A console game titled The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes is scheduled for release on May 14, 2027.

title: The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Film Reveals Trailer, Visual, May 2027 Debut, New Cast Member
content:
HIDIVE announced on Saturday that it will distribute The Eminence in Shadow - Lost Echoes ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!: Zankyō-hen ), the film based on the television anime of Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series, in 2027. "The Shadow's Gathering" fourth anniversary livestream for the anime revealed a new trailer, new visual, the May 2027 release date in Japan, and a new cast member for the film.

HIDIVE revealed an English subtitled version of the trailer and an English version poster.

A region-free version of the video without subtitles is available below.

Rie Kugimiya will join the cast as the voice of Minoru, a mysterious and handsome boy who appears before Akane.

Yukari Tamura also joins the film's cast as the new character Yūka Asakura. The returning cast members include :

• Seiichirō Yamashita as Cid Kagenou/Shadow

• Yui Horie as Akane Nishino

• Inori Minase as Beta

• Takehito Koyasu as Mordred

The first season of the anime premiered in October 2022, and it ended in February 2023. The second season premiered in October 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan along with a same-day English dub . HIDIVE and Kadokawa held a world premiere screening of the second season at Anime Expo in July 2023.

The main staff returned for the second season at the studio Nexus .

Kazuya Nakanishi (chief animation director for Darwin's Game ) directed the anime at Nexus ( Darwin's Game , Granbelm ). Makoto Iino ( Suppose a Kid From the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town , Demon Lord, Retry! ) adapted Tōzai 's original character designs for animation. Kanichi Katou ( Black Clover , Those Snow White Notes ) oversaw the series scripts. Kenichiro Suehiro composed the music.

Yen Press licensed both the light novels and the manga adaptation.

Aizawa began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in May 2018, and Kadokawa began publishing the story in physical volumes with art by Tōzai , beginning with the first volume in November 2018. Anri Sakano launched the manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine in December 2018. Seta U launched a spinoff manga titled Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Shadow Gaiden ( The Eminence in Shadow: Shadow Side Story ) in Comp Ace in July 2019.

The Eminence in Shadow : Master of Garden game launched for iOS, Android, and PC in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games released the game in English.

The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on the franchise , will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in 2027.

Rie Kugimiya will join the cast as the voice of Minoru, a mysterious and handsome boy who appears before Akane.
Yukari Tamura also joins the film's cast as the new character Yūka Asakura. The returning cast members include :
Seiichirō Yamashita as Cid Kagenou/Shadow
Yui Horie as Akane Nishino
Inori Minase as Beta
Takehito Koyasu as Mordred

The first season of the anime premiered in October 2022, and it ended in February 2023. The second season premiered in October 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan along with a same-day English dub . HIDIVE and Kadokawa held a world premiere screening of the second season at Anime Expo in July 2023.
The main staff returned for the second season at the studio Nexus .

Kazuya Nakanishi (chief animation director for Darwin's Game ) directed the anime at Nexus ( Darwin's Game , Granbelm ). Makoto Iino ( Suppose a Kid From the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town , Demon Lord, Retry! ) adapted Tōzai 's original character designs for animation. Kanichi Katou ( Black Clover , Those Snow White Notes ) oversaw the series scripts. Kenichiro Suehiro composed the music.
Yen Press licensed both the light novels and the manga adaptation.

Aizawa began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in May 2018, and Kadokawa began publishing the story in physical volumes with art by Tōzai , beginning with the first volume in November 2018. Anri Sakano launched the manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Comp Ace magazine in December 2018. Seta U launched a spinoff manga titled Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Shadow Gaiden ( The Eminence in Shadow: Shadow Side Story ) in Comp Ace in July 2019.
The Eminence in Shadow : Master of Garden game launched for iOS, Android, and PC in November 2022. Crunchyroll Games released the game in English.
The Eminence in Shadow : Phantom Echoes , a new 3D action roguelite game based on the franchise , will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in 2027.

title: The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Reveals Main Visual and Trailer, HIDIVE Confirms 2027 Release and Ongoing Production
content:
The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes has revealed a new main visual and trailer, while HIDIVE confirmed that it will distribute the anime film internationally in 2027. The first PV for the film was released in May 2024, which is when it was confirmed to be in production.

Lost Echoes is the first theatrical film in The Eminence in Shadow franchise and will serve as a feature-length sequel to the anime’s second season, which aired in 2023. HIDIVE previously streamed both seasons of the series during their original simulcast runs.

The new trailer continues the story following Shadow’s battle with Mordred. After being pulled through a mysterious gate, Shadow returns to Japan, the world where he previously lived as Minoru Kageno. However, his former home has become a ruined landscape overrun by magical beasts.

Beta follows him through the gate, while Akane Nishino, Minoru’s former classmate, is now fighting alongside a resistance movement. The story also introduces a mysterious amnesiac boy named Minoru and explores events surrounding the disappearance of the figure known as the “First Knight.” You can watch the English sub trailer below.

HIDIVE President John Ledford commented:

“We’re truly excited to share today’s news that The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes, the highly-anticipated feature-length sequel to The Eminence in Shadow series, will be released by HIDIVE in 2027 . This beloved isekai comedy has been a hit with anime fans since it first premiered in 2022 and were thrilled to continue our partnership with The Eminence in Shadow franchise as its exclusive international distributor. We look forward to sharing more news with fans in the weeks and months ahead. Whether you’re a long-time fan or completely new to The Eminence in Shadow, this upcoming holiday season provides the perfect time to binge watch the entire series before next year’s release of The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes.”

Staff:

• Director: Kazuya Nakanishi

• Screenplay: Kanichi Kato

• Character Design: Makoto Iino

• Animation Production: Nexus

Cast:

• Seiichiro Yamashita as Cid Kagenou / Shadow

• Yui Horie as Akane Nishino

• Inori Minase as Beta

• Yukari Tamura as Yuka Asakura

• Takehito Koyasu as Mordred

The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) is a Japanese light novel series by Daisuke Aizawa. Enterbrain has been serializing it with Tozai’s illustrations since 2018. There is also a manga adaptation by Anri Skano, which is serialized in Kadokawa Shoten. Yen Press is publishing both light novels and manga in English. The franchise has surpassed 8 million copies in circulation including its novels, manga adaptations, and digital editions.

HIDIVE currently streams both seasons of The Eminence in Shadow in the United States and Canada, as well as supported markets including the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

The franchise also has its first console game , The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes , set for a 2027 launch.

title: 'Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend' TV Anime Reveals Teaser Video
content:
The anime will premiere in 2027.

The anime will star :

• Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome

• Tomoya Itō as Rihito Ōtsuka

The manga's story centers on Rihito Ōtsuka — a laid-back and unbothered guy, and an employee in a game company, whose motto in life is to conserve energy — and Noa Saotome, his senior and an art director. Noa, a quintessential career woman, is deeply trusted by her superiors and admired by her juniors. But one day, Rihito accidentally discovers Noa's secret side that she strictly keeps hidden. This starts the "friends only" after-work relationship between Noa and Rihito.

Shinsuke Yanagi ( Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki , Senpai is an Otokonoko , High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World ) is directing the anime at feel. , Keiichirō Ōchi ( I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class , The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting , The Quintessential Quintuplets ) is in charge of series scripts, and Yumiko Yamamoto ( Seven Senses of the Re'Union , Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld , Yohane the Parhelion -SUNSHINE in the MIRROR ) is designing the characters.

Akiyama launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump magazine in 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on October 19.

Akiyama launched the Killer in Love ( Kimi ni Koisuru Satsujinki ) manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE and Ura Sunday services in January 2021. The manga ended in 2022. Comikey publishes the manga digitally in English.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Portraits of Delusion Sets January 6 Premiere on Disney+
content:
Disney+ announced on November 18 that Portraits of Delusion , the live-action adaptation of the webtoon Delusion , will premiere on January 6, 2027. The gothic mystery drama will stream internationally on Disney+ and in the United States on Disney+ and Hulu . The series was previously slated for the second half of 2026.

Set in 1930s colonial Korea, the series follows Iho, an artist fleeing the authorities, who takes a commission to paint a portrait of the owner of the mysterious Nammun Hotel. After meeting the owner's granddaughter, he becomes caught up in a conflict between vampires and those who hunt them.

Suzy, a former member of K-pop girl group Miss A, stars as Jeonghwa Song, the hotel's enigmatic resident, while Seonho Kim plays Iho. Jaerim Han adapted and directed the series.

The first four episodes will premiere on January 6, followed by three more episodes on January 13. The series will conclude with a two-part finale on January 20.

The series is based on the webtoon Delusion , which was created by Hongjacga and originally serialized in Korea from 2019 to 2020, followed by an English release in 2021. Set during the early 20th century under Japanese colonial rule in Korea, the story centers on the relationship between a mysterious vampire woman and an unknown painter.

The original webtoon is available to read in English on the WEBTOON platform. Inklore licensed the series in September 2025 and released the first volume in print on September 1. The company will publish the second volume in April 2027.

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Universe 6 Saiyans Deserve to Return for Their Own Arc
content:
What would the Saiyan race look like if it hadn’t been enslaved by Frieza and nearly exterminated? The Universe 6 Saiyans give us that alternate timeline in Dragon Ball Super , as they flourished as a peaceful nation that didn’t make its living conquering other worlds. The story of the Saiyans in Universe 7 is one of tragedy, but also plenty of self sabotage. The Planet Sadala Saiyans match up much more with Goku, Vegeta and the other Saiyans living on Earth. They defend what they love and their intentions are pure.

Cabba, Caulifla and Kale proved a quality trio in protecting their world in the Tournament of Power. Although they aren’t violent in nature like their sister universe Saiyans, when a fight comes their door, they answer the call. Universe 6 lasts a good chunk of the tournament, but it’s not nearly as strong as Universe 7. An arc about Goku and Vegeta training Universe 6 Saiyans and getting into a conflict with a rival planet would give fans new Saiyans to follow and potentially a whole new series offshoot.

New Saiyans Starting Off Stronger

In comparison to the beginning of Goku and Vegeta’s journeys as Saiyans, Cabba, Kale and Caulifla appear to be starting at a higher base level. The latent potential of the trio is higher than Goku, who achieved what he has through relentless work ethic. Those three gain a lot of their transformation power through getting enraged, instead of through standard work. This isn’t a bad thing, as it shows what they’re capable of with just a small push. However, it also shows there is a lot left to gain, especially with Kale who definitely drew comparisons to the original Broly with her Super Saiyan Berserk mode.

It takes quite a bit of pushing to get them into the fight, so maybe the new arc could be about their home world of Planet Sadala coming under threat. Vegeta takes Cabba under his wing and gets him ready for war, as they both feature deep pride in their Saiyan roots. While Caulifla and Kale work with Goku and Broly respectively to get the most out of their matching styles.

Caulifla might not match up with all the good traits of Goku, but her passion for fighting the strongest of the strong is just like him. Kale and Broly are meek fighters that turn into uncontrollable monsters at the peak of their powers. A hallmark trait of recent media put out in the Dragon Ball universe is that base forms carry a lot more power than they used to. These three carry that same trait and could give Goku and Vegeta a lot of potential to work with, and eventually good fighters to add to their team. Furthermore, a recent trend is bringing lower level Super Saiyan forms back into the mix, and all three haven’t gone above Super Saiyan 2.

Saiyan Pride Runs Super Deep

Universe 6’s Saiyans may feature good-natured personalities in comparison to their battle-hardened brethren, but don’t let that fool anyone. These Saiyans still share a fierce, protective love for their race with Universe 7 . A new series featuring the Universe 6 Saiyans can dive into that part of their DNA more. It’s the protagonist race of the series, but it’s not seen in its original element on an actual home world.

A trip to Sadala gives the fans a genuine look at that, essentially Planet Vegeta in the present. From low-level Bardocks to the high-level royals like King Vegeta, it’d open up a lot of possibilities for the Saiyans in Dragon Ball Super . Furthermore, the war that tore the other Saiyan planet apart would get a complete redo in this timeline. Cabba, Kale and Caulifla get to decide the fate of their planet from the very beginning. No servitude to an evil ruler, infighting amongst each other, and it would be just a great chance to keep the peace and defend the world from the traits that turned the original Saiyans into power hungry savages.

Goku and friends want to see them survive and thrive, but also know there is a constant threat from anywhere in the multiverse. Although the trio is a bit more diminutive than the Universe 7 Saiyans, their ability to transform and grow at a rapid rate shows how well they tapped into their Saiyan pride. Do you think Dragon Ball Super should do an arc on the newest Saiyans? Let us know in the comments.
